en.summary: This commit fixes modeled floating-point conversion semantics. The DPI-backed FPU path was passing a constant rounding-mode token into float-to-float conversion, and the shared FP helper code also missed required initialization for several conversion helpers, especially FP8 conversions used by the tensor-unit model.
why_it_counts: The patch changes the DPI-backed FPU model and shared floating-point helpers that define architectural execution in simulation.
The modified code directly changes numeric results and exception-flag behavior, not only tracing or CLI handling.
The tensor-unit simulator changes are consistent with the same conversion-semantics bug class.
disqualifiers: The commit includes one unrelated DPI trace import in VX_tcu_pkg.sv, which is not part of the bug fix.
evidence: VX_fpu_dpi.sv changes dpi_f2f from using FRM to using frm, so float-format conversion now uses the instruction-selected rounding mode.
sim/common/rvfloats.cpp adds rv_init(frm) to rv_ftod and the FP8 conversion helpers and initializes float8 and float32 wrapper fields explicitly before conversion.
sim/simx/tensor_unit.cpp starts calling the FP8 helper functions with explicit rounding-mode and flag arguments instead of older shorthand calls.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A modeled FPU conversion path must use the active instruction rounding mode and must initialize any software-floating-point helper state before performing a format conversion. If float-to-float conversion is hardwired to a constant rounding selector, or if helper wrappers for FP8 or other custom formats are used without initialization, the simulator or DPI-backed DUT model can produce numerically wrong conversions and incorrect exception flags even when the instruction stream is otherwise decoded correctly.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: modeled FPU conversion rounding and helper initialization
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: An instruction performs float-to-float conversion under a non-default rounding mode, or the model converts FP8 or related reduced-precision values used by tensor or matrix units.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Replace the dynamic rounding-mode argument with a fixed constant and skip helper-state initialization before reduced-precision conversions.
portability_notes: Map this to any simulator or DPI-backed FPU implementation that calls software conversion helpers.
The bug is semantic model behavior, so it is appropriate for a cycle-accurate or instruction-accurate DUT model dataset.
Keep opcode decode and operand extraction unchanged; only corrupt the conversion helper call contract.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the model-side helper call for float-to-float conversion and any reduced-precision conversion wrappers.
Replace the live instruction rounding-mode argument with a fixed compile-time or global constant.
Remove or bypass helper initialization that prepares soft-float state before FP8 or related format conversions.
Leave the surrounding decode and pipeline timing intact so the bug remains a pure modeled arithmetic-semantics regression.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DPI-backed FPU conversion helper calls and reduced-precision float helper initialization
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix passes frm instead of FRM into dpi_f2f, initializes soft-float helper state before FP-format conversions, and updates tensor-unit model calls to use the corrected helper signatures.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In VX_fpu_dpi.sv, restore the old constant FRM-like argument to dpi_f2f, and in sim/common/rvfloats.cpp remove the new rv_init(frm) calls and explicit FP8 helper initialization used before conversion.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Float-format conversions can round incorrectly, produce wrong FP8 values, or raise missing or incorrect exception flags in the modeled DUT path.
evidence_for_injection: The main RTL-adjacent change is exactly one rounding-mode argument on dpi_f2f, which is a direct semantic control input.
The shared rvfloats helper fixes all target initialization and rounding-state setup before conversion, indicating prior uninitialized or stale-state behavior.
The tensor-unit model had to update all FP8 helper calls consistently, tying the bug to reusable modeled-conversion semantics rather than one file-local typo.
notes: This is a DUT-model bug, not an FPGA-synthesis RTL bug, but it is still in scope under the dataset rules for cycle-accurate or instruction-accurate hardware models.
Non-default rounding modes and FP8 tensor workloads are the best triggers.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了建模浮点转换语义。DPI 驱动的 FPU 路径此前在 float-to-float 转换时传入的是固定舍入模式标记，而共享浮点辅助库也缺少若干转换前必须的初始化，尤其是 tensor-unit 模型里使用的 FP8 转换路径。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 DPI 驱动的 FPU 模型和共享浮点辅助函数，它们共同定义了模拟中的体系结构执行结果。
被修改的代码直接改变数值结果和异常标志行为，而不是只改 trace 或 CLI。
tensor-unit 模拟器的配套改动与同一类转换语义错误保持一致。
disqualifiers: VX_tcu_pkg.sv 中还包含一个与该 bug 无关的 DPI trace 导入改动，不属于本次修复核心。
evidence: VX_fpu_dpi.sv 把 dpi_f2f 从使用 FRM 改成了使用 frm，因此 float 格式转换现在会使用指令实际选择的舍入模式。
sim/common/rvfloats.cpp 在 rv_ftod 和各个 FP8 转换辅助函数中新增了 rv_init(frm)，并在转换前显式初始化 float8 与 float32 包装字段。
sim/simx/tensor_unit.cpp 开始用显式的舍入模式和标志参数调用 FP8 辅助函数，而不再使用旧的简写调用。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 一个被建模的 FPU 转换路径必须使用当前指令的实际舍入模式，并且在执行格式转换前正确初始化软件浮点辅助状态。如果 float-to-float 转换被硬连到固定舍入选择，或者 FP8 等自定义格式的辅助包装对象在转换前没有被初始化，那么 simulator 或 DPI 驱动的 DUT 模型即使解码完全正确，也会在数值转换和异常标志上给出错误结果。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 建模 FPU 转换的舍入模式与辅助状态初始化
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 指令在非默认舍入模式下执行 float-to-float 转换，或者模型要转换 tensor/matrix 单元使用的 FP8 等低精度格式。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 把动态舍入模式参数替换成固定常量，并在低精度格式转换前跳过辅助状态初始化。
portability_notes: 可映射到任何通过软件转换辅助函数实现的 simulator 或 DPI 驱动 FPU。
该缺陷属于语义模型行为，因此适合纳入面向 cycle-accurate 或 instruction-accurate DUT 模型的数据集。
保持 opcode decode 和操作数提取不变，只破坏转换辅助函数调用契约。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到模型侧调用 float-to-float 转换以及低精度格式转换辅助函数的位置。
把实时的指令舍入模式参数替换成固定的编译期常量或全局常量。
删除或绕过在 FP8 等低精度格式转换前准备 soft-float 状态的初始化步骤。
保持周围 decode 与流水时序不变，使回归保持为纯粹的建模算术语义错误。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DPI 驱动 FPU 的转换辅助函数调用，以及低精度浮点辅助状态初始化
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 dpi_f2f 的参数从 FRM 改成 frm，在 FP 格式转换前初始化 soft-float 辅助状态，并更新 tensor-unit 模型以调用修正后的辅助函数签名。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 VX_fpu_dpi.sv 中恢复旧的常量 FRM 风格参数传递给 dpi_f2f，并在 sim/common/rvfloats.cpp 中删除新增的 rv_init(frm) 调用以及 FP8 转换前的显式辅助状态初始化。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 在建模 DUT 路径中，浮点格式转换会以错误方式舍入、产生错误的 FP8 数值，或者给出缺失/错误的异常标志。
evidence_for_injection: 最关键的 RTL 邻近改动就是 dpi_f2f 的舍入模式参数，这本身就是直接控制语义的输入。
共享 rvfloats 辅助库在转换前系统性补上了初始化和舍入状态设置，说明此前存在未初始化或陈旧状态行为。
tensor-unit 模型必须一致地更新全部 FP8 helper 调用，说明这不是单文件拼写错误，而是可复用的建模转换语义问题。
notes: 这是 DUT 模型层面的错误，而不是面向 FPGA 综合的 RTL 错误；但根据数据集规则，cycle-accurate 或 instruction-accurate 硬件模型同样在范围内。
非默认舍入模式和 FP8 tensor 工作负载是最佳触发条件。
